text: Design moving compute to CI with intelligent routing, as the 2026-10-16 BRIEF.md addendum asks, planned through the new planning stage first. A job takes a median 25 min dispatch to outcome (producer ~12, verifier ~6, checks ~6 min), mostly cold cargo builds repeated per job. Decide per job what must run locally versus in CI, keep caches warm, avoid duplicate test runs, keep verification as strong, say how it fits with running jobs in parallel, and say how before/after wall time per verified result will be measured. Design only; get it reviewed.
